gloss: to fish up; to hike up (prices)

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {釣|つ}り{上|あ}げませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {釣|つ}り{上|あ}げていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {釣|つ}り{上|あ}げていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to fish up; to reel in; to catch and pull up
definitions.explanation: To pull a fish out of the water. Can also refer to lifting something up with a hook or line.

definitions.gloss: to raise; to hike up (prices, wages)
definitions.explanation: To artificially or forcefully raise prices, wages, or other values, often with a negative connotation of manipulation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{釣|つ}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I reeled in a big fish.
My father splendidly reeled in a sea bream.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{釣|つ}り{上|あ}げて、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んでいた→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The child was very happy to reel in a fish by themselves for the first time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{釣|つ}り{上|あ}げる。
⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{釣|つ}り{上|あ}げて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Resellers are driving up the prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まる→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{釣|つ}り{上|あ}げられること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When demand rises, prices can sometimes be hiked up.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is literal fishing. Sense 2 is figurative and carries a negative connotation of price manipulation or artificial inflation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{釣|つ}り{上|あ}げる (to reel in a fish)
- ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{釣|つ}り{上|あ}げる (to hike up prices)
- ⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{釣|つ}り{上|あ}げる (to drive up commodity prices)
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{釣|つ}り{上|あ}げる (to narrow one's eyes in anger — a separate idiomatic use)
